title: Accepting configuration predicate
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, natural numbers $d,c,A,a$, and a Boolean list $y$, write $x$ for the first component of the decoded pair represented by $y$. The accepting-configuration predicate is true exactly when the machine's accepting-language indicator accepts the encoding of $x$, the configuration specified by $N,d,c,y$ and width $2vwid(A,a,|x|)$, and the binary representation of $vrad(d,c,|x|)$.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet
